name: loosen-file-mode
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: relaxes the permission bits of an existing file WITHOUT touching its content -- use this for system files like /etc/shadow or /etc/passwd where insecure-file-mode (which rewrites the file) must never be used. Vars: FILE_PATH (required); FILE_MODE (required).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

: "${FILE_PATH:?FILE_PATH is required}"
: "${FILE_MODE:?FILE_MODE is required}"

if [ -e "$FILE_PATH" ]; then
    chmod -- "$FILE_MODE" "$FILE_PATH"
fi
